content: Iñaaventaitziro 10 evankaro
“Aririka impinkathariventantai Inkitesatzi, oshiyatyaaro 10 evankaro jatatsiri tsireni omonthaiyaari aavakaachane. Aayetanake ootamentopayeeni.
Tzimatsi okaratzi 5 evankaro kyoshiretaintsiri, tzimatsi eejatzi okaratzi 5 evankaro kaari kyoshiretatsine.
Irokapayeeni 5 evankaro kaari kyoshiretatsine aavetanakari ootamento, iro kantacha kapiche aanake iyaaki.
Irooma pashine kyoshiretaintsiri, aayetanake iroori ootamento, aanake eejatzi osheki iyaaki.
Tera impokitatyeeya thaankiini aavakaachane, ayimatapaakero ovochoki, magaiyanakeni.
Okanta niyankiite tsireni, okematzi ikaimaitzi, ikantaitzi: ‘¡Kaakitake aavakaachaneri, pomonthaavakyaari!’
Kakitaiyanakeni evankaro, ojaikiyetanairi iyaaki ootamentopayeeni.
Evankaropayeeni kaari kyoshiretatsine, okantavetanakaro kyoshiretaintsiri: ‘Pimpena iyaaki pootamento, irootaintsi intsivake nootamento naaka.’
Ari okantanake: ‘Eero nopimi, ari inkovityiimotakyaana naaka, piyaate pamanantapainte.’
Iyaaminthaitapaintzi amanantzi, areetapaaka aavakaachaneri. Irokapayeeni okaratzi aamaventainchari, omonthaavakari, jaanakero janta tsika iroimoshirenkaiteri. Jashitaitanakero ashitakorontsi.
Okanta opiyavetapaaka jatatsiri amanantzi, okaikaimavetapaaka, okantapaake: ‘¡Pashitaryeenaro naaka!’
Okematzi jakaitanakero, ikantaitziro: ‘Tetya niyotemi. Omapero.’
Ontzimatyeera paamaventayetaiya eeroka. Tema te piyote tsikapaite impiye Itomi Atziri.”
Jiñaaventaitziri kireeki
“Tema aririka impinkathariventantai Inkitesatzi, joshiyakotatyaari aparoni atziri kovatsiri iriyaate intaina, irapatotakeri iromperatane, ipanakeri iraamaventyaaniri okaratzi jashitari.

Ipoña ipakeri aparopayeeni iromperatane iireekite. Iriima pampithashiretachari kameetha, impanakeri ikaratzi 5 kireeki, pashine amataachari jiyotzi impanakeri ikaratzi apite, iriima pashine ovekaraantapaakarori impanakeri aparoni. Ipoña, jatake intaina.
Ikanta irika ipayeetakeri 5 kireeki, jantavaitakaakeri, joshekyaakeri jagai ikaratzi eejatzi 5.
Ari ikempitakari ipayeetakeri apite, joshekyaakeri irirori, jagai ikaratzi eejatzi apite.
Iriima pashine ipayeetakeri aparoni, jaanakeri iireekite, ikitatakeri kipatsiki.
Okanta osamanitake piyaa ashitariri kireeki, ikaimakaantapairi iromperatane iriyote opaita jantantakari iireekite.
Ari ipokapaake ipayeetakeri 5 kireeki, joñaakapairi pashine 5 kireeki joshekyaakeri, ikantapaake: Pinkatharí, 5 kireeki pipakena pairani, jirika pashine 5 noshekyagairi.
Ikantzi Pinkathari: ‘Arivé nomperatane, kameethashireri pinake. Kapiche kireeki pikempoyaakena, ari pinkempoyagai pashine osheki. Pimpoke, pintsipatyaana panintagaiya.’
Ipoña jareetapaaka ipayeetakeri apite kireeki, ikantapaake: ‘Pinkatharí, apite kireeki pipakena, jirika pashine apite noshekyagairi.’
Ari ikantzi Pinkathari: ‘Arivé nomperatane, kameethashireri pinake. Kapiche kireeki pikempoyaakena, ari pinkempoyagai osheki pashine. Pimpoke, pintsipatyaana panintagaiya.’
Ipoña jareetapaaka ipayeetakeri aparoni kireeki, ikantapaake: ‘Pinkatharí, niyotzi naaka mashiryaantzi pini, pampoyetanta pantavaitakaantziri piireekite, ari okanta poshekyaantariri.’
Iro notharovantakari, naakeri piireekite, nokitatakeri kipatsiki. Jirika iroñaaka namaimiri.
Ari jakanakeri ikantziri: ‘Kaariperoshire pinatzi osheki piperaneta. Piyovetaka ari nonkisakemi eerorika poshekyaanari kireeki,
piñaavetaka eero pimatziro eeroka, pamenemi impaitya antavaitakaimirine, ari iroshekineentakemi iroñaaka, iri pimpavainarimi nopiyaara.’
Ipoña ikantayeetakeri ikaratzi saikaintsiri: ‘Paapithateri kireeki, pimpairi pashine oshekyaakeriri 10 kireeki.’
Tema tsikarika itzimi otzimimotakeri, ari ontzimimotairi osheki. Iriroma kaari otzimimotzi, eekero iriyaatatye iriñeero eero otzimimoperotairi.
Paanakeri irika kaariperoshireri, pookeri tsika otsirenikitzi. Ari iriraavaityaari, iratsikaikivaitya inkemaantsivaitaiya.”
Iñaaventaitziro iyakoventaantsi
“Aririka impiye Itomi Atziri ñaapinkatha irovayeetairi. Intsipataiyaari maaroni maninkariite, inkempitaiyaari ikantaranki aparoni pinkathari isaikantaro ovaneenkatachari isaikamento.
Irapatotairi maaroni atziri tsikarika irisaikai irirori. Irinashiyetaiyaari iromisaikayetairi. Iroshiyakotyaari aparoni atziri nashitariri ipira te inkovakairi inkonovayetya.
Iromisaikairi ikovaperotziri irakojanoriki, iriima imanintayetziri irampateki iromisaikairi.

Impoña iriñaavaitake Pinkathari, iriñaanateri jinashitakari irakojanoriki, inkanteri: ‘Pimpoke maaroni, osheki intharomentakagaiyaami Ashitanari, pinampitaiyaaro tsika ipinkathariventantzi irirori, tema ari jovetsikanontakemiri pairani ovakera jovetsikantakarori kipatsi.
Tema piñaanaranki aavetana notashe, iro kantacha pipakena novarite. Piñaana ayimatana nomire, pipakena nirakeri. Piñaakena nareeta pinampiki, pineshinonkatakena pipankoki.
Piñaana nosaraakovaitzi, pipakena nokithaatari. Piñaana nomantsiyatake, pampitakotakena namataakotantaari. Jominkyaakaantaitakena, pipokashitakena piñaana.’
Impoña inkantaiyeni kameethashireri: ‘Pinkatharí. ¿Tsikapaite noñiimi pitasheneentzi, nopantamiri povarite? ¿Tsika noñiimi pimireneentzi, nopantamiri pimire?
¿Tsikapaite noñiimi, naakameethatantamiri nopankoki? ¿Tsika noñiimi pisaraakovaitzi, nopantamiri piithaare?
¿Tsikapaite noñiimi pimantsiyatzi, jashitakoitzimi, niyaatashitakemi noñiimi?’
Ari jakanake Pinkathari, ikantzi: ‘Tema pikaminthaakeriranki ikaratzi aventaayetanari noshiyakaantaari iyeki, aña naakatakera pikaminthaake. Omapero.’

Ipoña ipithokashitanakari jinashitakari irampateki, ikantziri: ‘Kaariperori, piyaate eeroka pinkemaantsitaiyaari paampari kaari tsivakanetaatsine, ikashiyakaitakariri kamaari intsipataiyaari maaroni imaninkarite irirori.
Aña piñaavetakana notasheneentzi, te pimpena noyaari. Ayimatakena nomire, te pimpena nomiretyaari.
Piñaavetana nareeta pinampiki, te pineshinonkatena pipankoki. Piñaavetana nosaraakovaitzi, te pimpena nonkithaatyaari. Piñaavetana nomantsiyatzi, jominkyaakaantaitakena, te pinkivantena.’

Impoña jakanake kaariperoshireri, ikantzi: ‘Novinkatharite, ¿tsikapaite noñaavetami pitasheneentzi, pimireneentzi, pikivantana, pisaraakovaitzi, pimantsiyatzi, jominkyeetakemi, temaita nonkaminthaayetemi?’
Ari ikantzi Pinkathari: ‘Tera pineshinonkayetantaiya, onkantavetakya iryaani irinayeete, naakatakera pantzimotake. Omapero.’
Irootake iratsipetantayeetyaarori kantaitaachaneri ashinonkaantsi. Iriima inkarate kameethashireyetaintsine, inkantaitaatyeero irañaayetai.”

footnotes.text: 25.33 Iri ikantakoitzi jaka oisha, iriitake piratsi ikovaperoitakeri jomisaikaitakeri akotsijanoriki. Iriima cabra, iri piratsi imanintayeetakeri jomisaikaitakeri ampatentsiki.
